mapper.select:
select fp.FINPROD_ID, /** 资产代码 */ fp.FINPROD_NAME, /** 资产名称 */ fp.FINPROD_TYPE, /** 存款类型 */ fp.VDATE, /** 起息日 */ fp.MDATE, /** 到期日 */ fp.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE, /** 本金收益特征*/ fp.CCY, /** 币种 */ fp.ISSUE_AMT, /** 存款本金 */ fp.CALENDAR_ID, /** 交易日历 */ fp.BLN_AREA, /** 境内外 */ fp.ISSUER, /**发行人*/ fp.TRADE_MARKET, /** 交易场所*/ (fp.mdate - fp.vdate) term, /** 期限 */ fpt.TYPE_2, /**核算分类*/ fpt.TYPE_1, /** 资产类型 */ (fccr.YIELD)*100 basicRate, fccr.REMARK remark, fccr.BASIS basis, /** 计息基础 */
fcpr.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, /*付息截止日营业日准则*/ fcpr.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, /*付息支付日营业日准则*/ fcpr.PAY_CYCLE, /** 付息频率 */ fcpr.CALC_RULE, /** 推算方式 */ fcpr.FIRST_PAY_DATE, /** 首次付息日 */ fccr.CALC_TYPE /**利率类型*/ from FIN_PRODUCT fp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.FINPROD_ID, a.YIELD,REMARK,a.BASIS,a.CALC_TYPE,a.BRANCH,
if(@FINPROD_ID=a.FINPROD_ID,@rank:=@rank+1,@rank:=1) asrowN FROM (SELECT * from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE order by EFF_DATE ASC) a, (select @rownum:=0,@FINPROD_ID:=null,@rank:=0) b ) WHERE rowN =1 ) fccr ON fp.FINPROD_ID = fccr.FINPROD_ID and fccr.BRANCH = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE WHERE CASH_ID IN (SELECT CASH_ID FROM FIN_CASH_INFO WHERE CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1}) ) fcpr ON fp.FINPROD_ID = fcpr.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fp.finprod_id = fpt.finprod_id where 1 = 1
and fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId}
select DATE_FORMAT(fccr.EFF_DATE, '%y-%m-%d') effDate,/**生效日*/ (fccr.YIELD)*100 yield/**利率*/ from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr where fccr.FINPROD_ID= #{finprodId} AND fccr.BRANCH = 0

select DATE_FORMAT(fcp.VDATE, '%y-%m-%d') vdate, /**界面-付息计划表.计息开始日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.MDATE, '%y-%m-%d') mdate, /**界面-付息计划表.计息结束日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.PAY_DATE, '%y-%m-%d') payDate, /**界面-付息计划表.理论支付日*/ fcp.INT_AMT intAmt/**界面-付息计划表.应计利息*/ from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp where fcp.FINPROD_ID= #{finprodId} and fcp.CASH_ID IN (SELECT CASH_ID FROM FIN_CASH_INFO WHERE CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1}) AND fcp.BRANCH = 0 order by vdate asc

select DATE_FORMAT(fcp.MDATE, '%y-%m-%d') repayDate, /**界面-还本计划表.还本日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.PAY_DATE, '%y-%m-%d') payDate, /**界面-还本计划表.支付*/ fcp.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, /**界面-付息计划表.理论支付日*/ fcp.INT_AMT intAmt/**界面-付息计划表.应计利息*/ from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp where fcp.FINPROD_ID= #{finprodId} and fcp.CASH_ID IN (SELECT CASH_ID FROM FIN_CASH_INFO WHERE CASH_TYPE_1 != #{cashType1}) AND fcp.BRANCH = 0 order by repayDate asc
